title: Dal Bhat
content: Ingredients: 1 cup rice, 1/2 cup lentils (dal), 1/2 tsp turmeric, salt to taste, vegetables (spinach, cauliflower, etc.), tomato achar. Instructions: 1. Rinse lentils and boil with turmeric and salt until soft. 2. In another pot, cook rice until fluffy. 3. Stir-fry seasonal vegetables with spices. 4. Serve rice with dal, vegetables, and achar.

title: Momo (Dumplings)
content: Ingredients: All-purpose flour, minced chicken or vegetables, garlic, ginger, onion, soy sauce, salt to taste. Instructions: 1. Knead dough using flour and water. 2. Mix filling ingredients together. 3. Roll dough, fill with mixture, and shape into dumplings. 4. Steam for 10 to 15 minutes or deep-fry. 5. Serve with spicy tomato achar.

title: Sel Roti
content: Ingredients: 2 cups rice flour, 1 ripe banana, 1/4 cup sugar, 1/2 cup water, ghee or oil for frying. Instructions: 1. Blend banana with water and sugar. 2. Mix with rice flour to form a thick batter. 3. Heat oil and pour batter in ring shapes. 4. Fry until golden and crisp.

title: Gundruk ko Jhol
content: Ingredients: 1 cup gundruk, 2 tomatoes, garlic, ginger, green chili, turmeric, mustard oil, salt to taste. Instructions: 1. Wash gundruk and soak if very dry. 2. Fry garlic, ginger, and chili in mustard oil. 3. Add tomatoes, turmeric, and salt. Cook until soft. 4. Add gundruk and water, simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Aloo Tama
content: Ingredients: 1 cup bamboo shoots (tama), 2 potatoes, 1/2 cup black-eyed peas, tomatoes, garlic, turmeric, cumin, salt to taste. Instructions: 1. Boil black-eyed peas and potatoes. 2. Fry garlic in oil, add tomatoes, turmeric, and spices. 3. Add bamboo shoots and cook for 5 minutes. 4. Mix everything and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Yomari
content: Ingredients: Rice flour, chaku (molasses), sesame seeds, ghee. Instructions: 1. Make dough with rice flour and warm water. 2. Mix chaku with sesame seeds and ghee. 3. Form dough into cone shapes, fill with mixture. 4. Steam for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Chatamari
content: Ingredients: Rice flour, water, minced meat, egg, onion, green chili, salt to taste. Instructions: 1. Make a thin batter with rice flour and water. 2. Pour onto pan like a pancake. 3. Add toppings and cover to cook. 4. Serve hot.

title: Thukpa
content: Ingredients: Noodles, chicken or vegetables, onion, garlic, green chili, tomatoes, soy sauce, spices, salt to taste. Instructions: 1. Cook noodles and set aside. 2. Stir-fry garlic, onion, and chili. Add tomatoes and meat/veggies. 3. Add water and soy sauce. 4. Add noodles and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Kwati
content: Ingredients: 1 cup mixed beans (soaked overnight), garlic, onion, ginger, spices, salt to taste. Instructions: 1. Boil beans until soft. 2. Fry garlic, onion, and ginger in oil. 3. Add spices and tomatoes. 4. Mix in boiled beans and simmer.

title: Bara (Lentil Pancake)
content: Ingredients: Black lentils, ginger, garlic, cumin, salt, oil. Instructions: 1. Soak and grind lentils into paste. 2. Mix with spices. 3. Heat oil on pan and fry like pancakes until both sides are crisp.
